Anya (Sales): @everyone quick sync — customer wants final PO and e-sign path today. procurement says they need certificate evidence for signer (bank letter or e-sign cert). also they want EOM net30 on the orderform. can we confirm sign sequence and any blocker from legal/finance? :wave:
Karen (Finance): EOM net30 ok if legal confirms we can invoice on acceptance. need billing contact and tax ID. also confirm whether invoice goes to their finance portal or email `acctspay@customer.com`. :memo:
Joe (Legal): On the MSA/DPA redlines — customer pushed for SLA uptime language and a termination-for-convenience carveout. i'm ok with SLA tweaks but not the carveout without ramped notice/credits. ask them for specific clause text. Joe (Legal): Regarding signer certificate: prefer organization e-sign certificate (DocuSign/AdobeID) plus matching PO with authorized signer name. bank letter only if they require wet-ink.
Marta (Procurement Ops): They also asked for a signer certificate chain because their vendor onboarding team wants cryptographic proof. if we provide the e-sign envelope audit trail + signer certificate doc, will that clear it?
Tim (Eng): From engineering: no technical blockers. if they ask for KMS/HSM attestations in contract, we can provide our SOC2 and we can confirm key handling, but we cannot share raw key material. for private deployments we can do extra CA docs — but that's a separate contract.
docu-sign-bot: Envelope 0x9f3c submitted by anya@redwood.ai — status: pending signature. link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0x9f3c (automated update)
Anya (Sales): OK action items: 1) Joe to propose alternate SLA language and a short do-not-delete signer-auth checklist. 2) Karen to confirm billing contact and whether invoice via portal. 3) Marta to confirm if audit trail + e-sign cert satisfies their vendor team. 4) I'll push the DocuSign envelope and attach PO `PO-34871` once we have signer name.
Joe (Legal): Draft for SLA tweak (first pass): "Scheduled uptime commitment 99.5% monthly, service credits capped at 50% of monthly invoice for repeated breaches, with 30 days cure period." also adding a paragraph: "Authorized signer must be an officer or designated procurement representative; e-sign certificate and envelope audit trail accepted as evidence of authorization." please review.
Karen (Finance): Billing contact set: `Lola Martinez <acctspay@customer.com>` and tax ID `12-3456789`. Portal billing only for >$100k deals, so we'll send email invoice. Net30 EOM confirmed.
Marta (Procurement Ops): Confirmed — audit trail + e-sign cert will satisfy vendor onboarding. they might still request a notarized bank letter if their compliance is strict, but we'll surface that as exception.
Anya (Sales): Great. Putting this in the envelope: orderform snippet attached to DocuSign: ```
Order Form: Redwood Inference
Customer: Acme Widgets Inc.
PO: PO-34871
Term: 12 months
Billing: Net30 EOM
Tier: Dedicated - 2x A100
Price: $48,000/mo
```
Tim (Eng): FYI if they want a certificate chain we can export the signing certificate metadata from the DocuSign audit (thumbprint + issuer). that'll likely be enough for procurement.
Joe (Legal): I'll add the signer-auth checklist into the DocuSign envelope as an extra document and send over redline summary. also flagging termination carveout — will propose language tying any convenience termination to pro-rata invoice and 60 days notice.
Anya (Sales): Perfect. I'll update the envelope, attach MSA/DPA redline summary, and tag @Joe and @Karen for approval before sending. target: get signature by EOD. :crossed_fingers:

Anya (Sales): :tada: Received — thanks team. next: finance will issue invoice, legal to close redlines and upload final MSA to S3. I'll post final artifacts in the deal record.
